reasoning: The icon clearly combines a stopwatch silhouette with a central play triangle, universally understood as 'start timer', 'stopwatch', or 'time tracking'. It fits tasks about time-tracking tools (Toggl, Harvest), timed practice/exams, interval workouts, and physical timers, though at tiny sizes it shares visual elements with both a standard stopwatch and a media play button.
